final.memo:
We view this position as a durable franchise that continues to demonstrate its value through consistent profitability and substantial deposit scale [D01]. The first-quarter performance, showing improved net income and earnings per share, confirms that the underlying business engines—consumer banking, wealth management, and global banking—are operating effectively [D01, D03]. 

While we remain mindful of credit cycles, funding costs, and the duration exposure inherent in the banking industry, the company maintains capital ratios and liquidity that meet our standard for strength [D02, D05]. We do not attempt to time the market or trade around quarterly earnings fluctuations; our focus remains on the long-term earning power of the business [D03, D07]. 

At the current valuation, there is no catalyst to trigger a sale [D04]. We consider the tax consequences of exiting such a substantial position and prefer to retain our ownership in a business that provides attractive returns on capital [D04, D08]. We will continue to monitor the company's ability to navigate the credit environment and manage its capital allocation prudently [D05, D08].
